title: westringia brevifolia var. raleighii
intro: Westringia brevifolia var. raleighii, commonly known as Dampiera raleighii, is a flowering plant species native to Western Australia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it useful for wound healing and skin care. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids have been identified in the plant, contributing to its medicinal properties.
